content: कर्बु(र्वु)र {%a.%} .²1 Variegated, or spotted; क्वचिल्लसद्घननिकुरम्बकर्बुरः <ls>Śi. 17. 56</ls>. .²2 Of the colour of pigeons, whitish, grey; पवनैर्भस्म कपोतकर्बुरम् <ls>Ku. 4. 27</ls>. .{@-रः@} .²1 The variegated colour. .²2 Sin. .²3 An evil spirit, demon. .²4 The Dhattūra plant. .²5 Rice growing amidst inundation. .{@-रा@} <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (वर्वरी). .{@-री@} An epithet of Durgā. .{@-रम्@} .²1 Gold. .²2 Water. .²3 The Dhattūra plant.
